common.networkError: The connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Refresh the page and try again.
common.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or this profile isn’t shared with you.

page.title: Olympiad
page.sub: Online stages only give a ticket to the final; prizes are awarded at in-person finals.
page.loadErrorTitle: We couldn’t load the olympiad data
page.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again. The ticket and registrations are saved — nothing is lost.
page.emptyBody: No olympiad has been announced for {name}’s grade this season. We’ll text you when a new stage opens.
page.coNote: Only the profile owner, {owner}, registers {name} for olympiad stages. You can see everything but not change it.
page.yourStagesSub: Registration, taking part and results — stage by stage.

desc.autumn_online: Open to all. No big prizes — only a way into the next stage.
desc.mini_final: By invitation: the strongest of the autumn stage in each region.
desc.spring_online: Qualifier for the final. Not needed after 3 or more waves.
desc.spring_final: Main prizes are awarded only here. The one supervised measurement.

ticket.earnedTitle: Ticket to the spring final earned
ticket.earnedBody: {name} has taken {waves} monitoring waves this season, and {needed} are enough for a ticket. So {name} goes straight to the final — no spring online qualifier.
ticket.progressBody: With {needed} monitoring waves {name} goes straight to the final. Otherwise the way is through the spring online stage: the best-placed there qualify for the final.

reason.closed: Registration for this stage is closed.
reason.needs_ticket_or_qualification: The final needs a ticket (3 monitoring waves) or a high place in the spring online stage — the best-placed there qualify.
reason.needs_invitation: The mini-final is by invitation: the strongest of the autumn online stage in each region are invited.
reason.no_form: This stage isn’t ready yet. We’ll text you when it opens.

action.registeredOnline: {name} is registered. It can be taken at home any day while the stage is open.
action.registeredUpcoming: {name} is registered. The stage opens on {date} — we’ll text you.
action.taken: Taken — results after the stage closes.
action.handOver: Hand the device to {name}: the questions open in kid mode.
action.cancelBody: {name}’s registration will be cancelled. While the stage is open you can register again.
action.cancelBodyVenue: The seat is freed and may go to another child. While registration is open you can sign up again.
action.checkedIn: {name} was checked in at the entrance.

venue.pickSub: Venues in {region}. Each shows its start date and time.
venue.none: No venues in {region} have been announced yet. We’ll text you when they are.
venue.adultBody: The accompanying adult should be the profile owner, {owner}. ID is checked against the profile at the entrance.
venue.bring3: Two pencils and an eraser — scrap paper is provided
venue.bring4: Water and a light snack; arrive 30 minutes early
venue.sms: We’ll text the exact address and start time 10 days before the stage.

result.noBand: Not enough children in this cohort yet
result.noBandBody: We show a range once at least 30 children are in the cohort — only then is it reliable.
result.onlineNote: The online stage is taken at home without supervision, so it carries no big prizes — it only opens the way to the final. Prizes are awarded at in-person finals.
result.finalNote: This stage was supervised — the one controlled measurement of the season.
result.noCertBody: Certificates go only to the top {pct}% in the region. Instead there is a diagnostic report that shows what to work on.
result.invitedBody: The autumn result opened {name}’s way to the regional mini-final.
result.qualifiedBody: The spring online result opened {name}’s way to the final.
result.diagSub: Relative to {name}’s own overall result — never compared with other children.

standing.in_line: In line with the overall result

result.skillsEmpty: Not enough answers for a skills map this time.

awards.placeBody: Congratulations! The prize is handed over by the final’s organisers.
awards.cupBody: The Cup combines the autumn and spring results and — always — the gain between them. A child who climbs steadily all season can win it without being at the very top.
awards.cupNote: Cup standings are calculated after the spring final and shown only to you.
awards.cupWon: {name} took place {n} in the season cup

privacy.pv1T: Rankings are visible only to you
privacy.pv1B: No public tables or lists of names — ever. {name} sees personal progress, not a place.
privacy.pv2B: A partner receives results only with your separate consent to third-party transfer.

marathon.when: {from} – {to} · online, at home · picture questions with spoken instructions
marathon.body: Grades 0–2 have no places and no ranking: at this age a ranking measures chance, not ability. {name} gets a skills map instead — strong here, emerging, not yet.
marathon.registeredBody: It can be taken at home any day during the stage.

errors.STAGE_NOT_FOUND: This stage no longer exists. The page has been refreshed.
errors.VENUE_NOT_FOUND: This venue no longer exists. Choose another.
errors.NOT_ELIGIBLE: This stage can’t be registered for right now. The page has been refreshed.
errors.VENUE_FULL: This venue is full. Choose another.
errors.VENUE_PROCTORED_BY_GUARDIAN: A member of your family proctors this venue. Choose another.
errors.ALREADY_CHECKED_IN: Your child is already checked in or has started — the seat can no longer change.
errors.ALREADY_TAKEN: The stage has already been taken — the registration can’t be cancelled.
errors.STAGE_CLOSED: The stage is closed; nothing can be changed.
errors.IN_PERSON_STAGE: This stage is in person — it’s taken at the venue.
errors.STAGE_NOT_OPEN: The stage hasn’t opened yet or has already closed.
errors.STAGE_NOT_READY: The stage’s questions aren’t ready yet. Try again a little later.
errors.ENTRY_TAKEN: This stage has already been taken.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Only the profile owner can register.
errors.NETWORK: The connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.

public.sub: Online stages only give a ticket to the final; prizes are awarded at in-person finals.
public.marathonSub: No places and no ranking — every child gets a skills map.
public.privacyTitle: Results go to the family only
public.privacyBody: No public tables or lists of names — ever. Only the parents see the result.
public.ctaSignedOut: Sign in and register your child
public.ctaHint: Registration is in the “Olympiad” section of your child’s page.
public.notFoundBody: The link may be wrong or out of date. Current olympiads are on your child’s page.
public.errTitle: We couldn’t load the olympiad data
public.errBody: Check your connection and try again.
